products.name: MEDICUBE PDRN Pink Collagen Capsule Cream 55g
products.description: The Medicube PDRN Pink Collagen Capsule Cream is a dual-texture Korean skincare moisturizer featuring encapsulated pink collagen capsules in a transparent hydrating gel. It utilizes salmon-derived PDRN, 5% niacinamide, and hyaluronic acid to deliver deep hydration, improve skin elasticity, and create a luminous glass-skin glow.

products.name: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Poremizing Fresh Ampoule 50ml
products.description: The SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Poremizing Fresh Ampoule is a 50ml pore-clarifying facial serum formulated with Himalayan pink salt, Madagascar Centella Asiatica, and a 9-peptide complex. It deeply purges pore impurities, controls excess sebum, and restores skin elasticity for a smoother, tighter complexion.
